Message:
Namespace rehearsal phase markers so they never resume a real run (#799)

* Namespace rehearsal phase markers so they never resume a real run (I11660)

A weekly-SF rehearsal writes backtest phase markers at the same keys as the
real Saturday run, so a real run on the same date could auto-skip a phase on
the strength of a rehearsal's marker. Rehearsal runs (RUN_TOKEN starting
"rehearsal-", or AE_PIPELINE_ROLE=rehearsal) now read and write markers under
backtest/{date}/.phases/.rehearsal/{token}/. Real runs and real reruns keep
the shared key unchanged.

Refs nousergon/alpha-engine-config#11660

Author: Claude
Message:
fix(spot): demote reclaimed pools, go on-demand on the last attempt, arm the trap before launch

Port of nousergon-data PR1944 (I11565) and PR1958 (I11574) into this repo's
_spot_common.sh (alpha-engine-config-I11573).

- New infrastructure/_spot_relaunch.sh mirrors nousergon-data's helper: a
  confirmed reclaim records the box's type and subnet per RUN_TOKEN, later
  launches in the run move them to the back of the rotation, and the final
  attempt of a relaunch chain launches with `krepis.ec2_spot launch --no-spot`
  (LaunchMarket/LaunchReason tagged). A spot-quota refusal goes on-demand on
  the next attempt.
- spot_common_launch_instance installs the cleanup EXIT trap before it
  launches. The nine stage scripts no longer install it afterwards, so an
  ec2_spot exit 64/65 now reaches cleanup, which relaunches within the budget.
- cleanup asks relaunch-decision on every attempt so a last-attempt reclaim is
  still recorded, and it skips terminate-instances when nothing launched.

Refs nousergon/alpha-engine-config#11573

Message:
fix(evaluator): rehearsal runs can never write live config (alpha-engine-config-I11505) (#790)

* fix(sim): count same-batch orders against the exposure caps; resolve PIT executor params from S3 history

Two P1 findings from the 2026-09-23 weekly SF rehearsal
(rehearsal-2026-09-23-2).

alpha-engine-config-I11504 -- the simulated book breached the 90% equity cap.
executor.deciders.decide_entries checks every candidate with
risk_guard.check_order against current_positions as it stood BEFORE the batch
and never adds approved orders to it, so a batch whose orders each fit is
approved in full when their sum does not. The backtester imports that decider,
so _simulate_single_date now re-walks the plan in approval order counting the
notional already kept from the same batch (synthetic/batch_exposure.py) before
anything fills, and the vectorized sweep gets the same accumulation as gate 14
in compute_vectorized_entries. Sector cap handled the same way. The two
live-parity replays opt out, because their job is to agree with what the live
executor did, and the live decider has the same defect (reported on the issue;
executor code is not changed here).

alpha-engine-config-I11503 -- walk-forward backtests simulated genesis
executor params. config_archive resolved only from config/CHANGELOG.json, and
the assembler, which has been the sole live writer since cutover, writes the
live key and config/{type}_history/{YYMMDDHHMM}.json but never indexes the
changelog. The changelog held 16 scanner_params entries and 0 executor_params
entries. resolve_as_of now also reads the snapshots on S3 (history prefix plus
live key), with knowledge date = max(date named by the key, LastModified), so
no key name can backdate an object. A genesis fallback is recorded and becomes
a write_health warning, which makes the Backtester, PredictorBacktest and
Evaluator health status "degraded" rather than logging an INFO line. Checked
read-only against the live bucket: as-of 2026-09-23 resolves executor_params
to executor_params_history/2609191405.json (min_score 75, max_position_pct
0.1), research_params to the live key (2026-05-02) and scanner_params to
2608221359.json, with no degraded warnings.

Refs alpha-engine-config-I11504, alpha-engine-config-I11503,
alpha-engine-config-I11445.

* Refuse live config writes from rehearsal runs (alpha-engine-config-I11505)

The weekly-SF rehearsal rehearsal-2026-09-23-2 ran EvaluatorOptimize with
cutover on and wrote production config/executor_params.json. Nothing in the
evaluator knew it was a rehearsal: the SF's pipeline_role never reached the
spot instance.

- optimizer/run_role.py: detect a rehearsal from RUN_TOKEN (the SF execution
  name krepis.ssm_log_capture exports) or AE_PIPELINE_ROLE=rehearsal.
- evaluate.py / backtest.py: a rehearsal is forced into --freeze right after
  argument parsing, before anything can write.
- Backstops at the two live-write sites --freeze did not reach: the
  assembler's _cutover_apply and predictor_optimizer.apply_recommendations
  raise RehearsalLiveWriteRefused. backtest.py's predictor apply is now
  freeze-gated too.
- _spot_common.sh / spot_backtest.sh forward a sanitised RUN_TOKEN onto the
  spot.
- apply_audit.py: document that the audit is a post-hoc record, not a gate,
  and that it runs after the assembler; tests pin that ordering.
